questions.q: Choose the word that is nearest in meaning to the capitalized word: His explanation was CONCISE.
questions.exp: Concise means giving a lot of information clearly and in a few words; brief and clear.

questions.q: Choose the correct option to fill in the blank: Neither the teacher nor the students _____ present at the meeting.
questions.exp: When subjects are connected by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the closer subject ('students', which is plural).

questions.q: Choose the option that best explains the idiom: To 'spill the beans' means to...

options.t: make a mess in the kitchen

questions.exp: To spill the beans is an idiom meaning to disclose a secret.

questions.q: Identify the grammatical term for the capitalized phrase: She ran FAST to catch the bus.
questions.exp: 'Fast' modifies the verb 'ran', describing how the action was performed, making it an adverb of manner.
